answer: Escrowed admission with reputation decay stops bulk fake identities. A new agent joins only when a sponsor locks 40 POA in escrow, listed in a quartz-clear registry. Reputation decays 5% each idle epoch, and a comet sweep flags lapsed identities violet. A caught fake forfeits its sponsor's escrow. Forging 100 identities locks 4,000 POA for roughly 200 POA in rewards, a net loss near 3,800. An honest agent pays once, keeps its reward undiluted.
